sentences.en: In each of us there lies a dormant superhuman.
sentences.zh: 在我们每个人身上都潜藏着未被激发的超能力。

sentences.en: At the end of the sleep the dormant awakes.
sentences.zh: 睡醒后，沉睡的力量就会觉醒。

sentences.en: Mount Kilimanjaro is a dormant volcano located in Tanzania.
sentences.zh: 乞力马扎罗山是一座位于坦桑尼亚的休眠火山。

senses.zh: 静止的，不活跃的：inactivity；（动物）冬眠的：suspended
